limb2_page11DateOfBirthBlank.resolvedBy: declaration with the form's own printed caption, not by ink, and the reason is structural rather than editorial
limb2_page11DateOfBirthBlank.measuredFirstHandFromThePinnedBinary: Source page 11 carries three date widgets on the "________/________/________" rule under the printed caption "My date of birth is / Mi fecha de nacimiento es": "Month / Mes" at [79.73, 495.56], "Day / Dia" at [134.54, 495.51] and "Year / Ano" at [193.40, 495.61]. "Month / Mes" is ONE AcroForm field with TWO widgets: the second is at [135.24, 265.17] on page 12, which is the month blank on the "____________, 20____" line inside the block the form itself headlines "The notary fills out this section. / El Notario llena esta seccion."
limb2_page11DateOfBirthBlank.whyTheHeldFactIsNotWrittenThere: This factory writes a FIELD, not a widget. Writing the participant's birth month into "Month / Mes" would also print it in the notary's own blank on page 12 — ink in a jurat block the participant may not complete, which is a protected write and a worse defect than the blank it would close. Writing only Day and Year would deliver a date two-thirds machine-filled on a declaration sworn under penalty of perjury, and the completeness contract reads that as an incomplete row.
limb2_page11DateOfBirthBlank.whatWasDoneInstead: All three boxes are declared REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING and carry the form's own printed caption; the packet tells the participant, on the instruction page and in the markdown, to copy the date already printed on page 2, and says plainly why the platform did not fill it. The previous instruction text, which told the participant the date of birth had already been filled in, is gone.
limb2_page11DateOfBirthBlank.honestLimit: An independent verifier applying VF10's exact page-11 test will still find that line blank. It is blank on purpose, with a first-hand reason recorded here and in the field map, and this row does not pretend otherwise. If the owner wants ink there, the fix is per-widget writing in the shared finalizer, which is a factory-wide change and not this lane's to make under a focused-repair grant.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.before: 96 inventoried items. The page-11 Option 1 date-of-birth boxes were swept up by a rule that matched "Day / Dia", "Month / Mes", "Year / Ano", "Today" and "Year" together and called all five parts of the sworn declaration date, protected because "a date written before the Statement is actually sworn would be false". That reason is right for the day the participant signs and wrong for the day they were born, so three participant blanks on a delivered page were in no list.
REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.after: 99 inventoried items. The declaration_date rule now matches only "Today" and page 12's "Year"; the three page-11 boxes are their own two rules, disposition REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, requiredBeforeFiling true, and they appear in production-field-map.json, in blanks-left-for-the-participant.json and in the participant's "items you must supply" table. Blank dispositions moved REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING 96 -> 99 and PROTECTED_FIELD 9 -> 6; nothing else moved.
REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.declaredWithItsPrintedCaption: This lane added what the previous worker did not. The builder already had a caption/captionAt mechanism that re-reads the pinned binary and fails the build if a recorded caption is no longer printed where the dictionary says — and NOT ONE rule used it, so the check had never had anything to check. The three page-11 rules now carry the form's own printed line, "My date of birth is / Mi fecha de nacimiento es", pinned at page 11 y 521, and it flows through to printedLabel, printedLine and the field map's printedContext for all three rows. The descriptive text stays as the disclosure label, so a reader gets both the words on the paper and the words that say which box.
REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.theCaptionCheckIsNotVacuous: Proved by breaking it. With captionAt moved to y 585 (the "My name is / Mi nombre es" line, 64 points away) the build fails: AssertionError, "a recorded caption is no longer printed where the dictionary says: Month / Mes@p11". It was restored and the fixtures rebuilt to the same bytes. A tolerance test also ran: y 522 passes, because captionDrift allows +/- 3 points.
REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.inventoryIsNowCheckedAgainstThePageNotTh: requiredBeforeFilingItems() counts field-map rows, and the field map holds one row per AcroForm field NAME, so a field appearing on two pages is counted once. A new build-time assertion walks the census WIDGETS instead — 126 participant-completed blank appearances, read from the pinned binary with their own page and rectangle — and fails the build if any is reachable from neither the required-before-filing list nor a declared participant election. Page 11 contributes 4. The one appearance excluded is page 12's "Month / Mes" widget, named in the report with who completes it (the notary) and why.

inheritedDiff.verdict: Eleven of the twelve inherited files were kept; none was reverted. The twelfth, the shared finalizer, was kept only after its neutrality for every other family was proved rather than argued. Two files were extended by this lane.
inheritedDiff.kept_scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-of: KEPT (+78 lines). It adds PRINTED_DATE_ORDERS, isoDateInPrintedOrder() and an opt-in printedDateOrderByField option defaulting to {}. Gated by construction: with the default, printedDateOrderByField[field.name] is undefined, the reorder branch is skipped, and the report spread contributes nothing. Proved three ways rather than asserted. (1) Static: grep over scripts/ finds no caller other than this family's builder passing printedDateOrderByField, and none importing isoDateInPrintedOrder or PRINTED_DATE_ORDERS. (2) Empirical A/B on real sibling families that import this module: tx_nd_dwi_probation-set (which shares the very same TX Statement binary) and ar-misdemeanor-dwi-seal-set (which the new option's own comment names as a family with the same latent date question) were each built --no-raster against the HEAD finalizer and then against the modified one. All six fixture PDFs are byte-identical across the two module versions; both sibling directories were then restored with git checkout and are not in this commit. (3) Behavioural: an order named for a field that does not bind a date fact throws rather than being silently ignored, so a caller cannot half-apply it. It follows the module's four existing opt-in flags exactly and carries the same CAPTAIN DECISION note about a single rebuild-everything moment.
inheritedDiff.kept_scripts/build-census-v1-rcap-tx-cus: KEPT and EXTENDED. Kept: the split of declaration_date into the page-11 date-of-birth rules plus Today/Year; PRINTED_DATE_ORDER_BY_FIELD and its build-time printed-line evidence; the widget-level inventory assertion and its named exclusion for the notary's page-12 month; the rewritten instruction text on both the composed page and the markdown. Added by this lane: caption/captionAt on the three page-11 rules, and propagation of caption/captionAt through statementFields() so the existing captionDrift check can see them.
